items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 18 at 1:05PM PST until November 20 at 9:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Surf of 4 to 6 feet. Sets to 8 feet along west-facing
beaches expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From Thursday morning through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Increased risk for rip currents. Areas of coastal
flooding possible during high tide each morning along
boardwalks and parking lots.


* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
items.instruction: Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 18 at 1:18PM PST until November 20 at 10:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas
5 to 8 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from San Mateo Point to the Mexican
Border and out to 10 nm and Waters from San Mateo Point to the
Mexican Border Extending 10 to 60 nm out including San
Clemente Island.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Thursday to 10 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
